summary: Backend-only iteration 3 for MSG91 SMS OTP integration in dev-fallback mode (AUTHKEY set, TEMPLATE_ID intentionally empty pending DLT approval). Added /app/backend/tests/test_msg91_otp.py with 14 new tests covering: provider='dev' response field, otp_dev + universal 123456 fallback, phone normalization (bare 10-digit → +91XXXXXXXXXX, '00' prefix stripped, '+' preserved, whitespace/dashes stripped), invalid phone rejection (letters, <10 digits, empty → 400), verify with returned otp_dev, verify with wrong OTP → 401, /auth/me works after normalized-phone login, and idempotent login with two phone formats resolves to the same user_id. Full suite = 75 tests (40 iter1 + 21 iter2 + 14 iter3), 75/75 PASS serially in 8.6s. Startup log verified: 'MSG91 disabled (no TEMPLATE_ID (waiting on DLT approval)). Using dev-mode OTP with 123456 fallback.'. All previously-passing regression tests still pass. NOTE on parallel xdist run: 74/75 pass under -n 2; the single flake is a pre-existing cross-worker fixture-scope artifact in TestDoctorPatients.test_doctor_patients_list (session-scoped patient_session on gw1 has no file uploaded because TestFiles ran on gw0's patient), not a regression from MSG91 changes.

minor.issue: server.py:458 uses `raw if len(raw) > 10 else f"{MSG91_DEFAULT_CC}{raw}"` — for raw of exactly length 11 (unusual but possible, e.g. leading digit like '91XXXXXXXXXX' typed without '+'), the CC is NOT prepended, which is the right behavior for pre-CC'd 91XXXXXXXXXX but silently keeps arbitrary 11-digit garbage. Consider validating length ∈ {10, 12} when no '+' or '00' was given, or explicitly detect a leading '91' before deciding.

In DEV mode the endpoint returns the raw `otp_dev` in the response body. This is intentional for testing, but consider gating it behind an explicit APP_ENV=dev flag before shipping to production so a mis-configured prod (missing TEMPLATE_ID) doesn't leak OTPs to callers.

server.py:540-557 — when provider=='msg91' but the OTP row has expired, the code correctly rejects. However there is no path that lets a caller retry via 123456 after an msg91 send actually succeeded and the user typed a wrong OTP: the code first sets valid=True on '123456' before hitting the row-based branch, so this is fine. Noting for completeness — behavior is correct.
Universal fallback '123456' works even when NO prior /request was made. Documented + intentional per credentials file, but flagged so it isn't lost in production.

action_items: (Optional) Gate the `otp_dev` field in /auth/otp/request behind an explicit APP_ENV=dev flag so a production instance with a missing TEMPLATE_ID does not leak OTPs.
(Optional) Tighten phone-normalization: explicitly detect leading '91' vs. arbitrary 11-digit input; today `len(raw) > 10` treats any 11-digit number as pre-CC'd.

(Optional, pre-existing) Fix the xdist cross-worker flake in TestDoctorPatients.test_doctor_patients_list — the session-scoped patient_session fixture is created independently on each worker so it can drift from TestFiles' upload; either move that suite to a single worker (loadfile scope already, but the assertion `files_count >= 1` on the doctor's global patient list depends on which worker's patient_session got the file). Serial run (`-n 0`) is 75/75 green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 883 lines — still over the 700-line split threshold noted last iteration; MSG91 branching adds ~40 lines to the OTP handlers. Recommend moving auth into /app/backend/routers/auth.py.
Duplicate normalization block in request_otp (l.450-461) and verify_otp (l.517-524) — extract `_normalize_phone(raw) -> (digits, stored_phone)` helper to avoid drift.
MSG91 API calls use `params=...` with POST which sends them as query string — that matches MSG91's v5 OTP API contract, so it's correct, just non-obvious; consider a short comment.
MSG91_ENABLED is evaluated once at import time. Rotating TEMPLATE_ID in .env requires a backend restart (documented by supervisor rules, but worth noting).
requests library is used synchronously inside async endpoints but is correctly wrapped in run_in_threadpool — good.
MongoDB _id excluded via projection {'_id': 0} everywhere including new otp_codes collection reads — good.
No index on otp_codes.phone or otp_codes.expires_at; consider TTL index on expires_at to auto-purge stale codes.

success_rate.backend: 100% (75/75 serial) / 98.7% (74/75 parallel due to pre-existing xdist flake)

seed_data_creation: test_msg91_otp.py creates ~10 TEST_ patients per run using random Indian phones (+91999xxxxxxx, +91993/992/991xxxxxxx) and bare 10-digit variants. All records prefixed with 'TEST' in names. Universal OTP 123456 used throughout. Uses conftest.py session-scoped patient_session + doctor_session fixtures. No production data touched.

Under default parallel `-n 2 --dist loadscope`, 1 pre-existing flake in TestDoctorPatients.test_doctor_patients_list due to cross-worker session-scoped fixture drift — NOT related to MSG91 iteration.
